policy.scope: Post-hoc comparison of existing ordinary and compiled runs; no new timings
policy.method: Existing exact tied-rank Mann–Whitney plus Holm, 10% practical threshold
policy.families: All eligible schemas x two runtimes x two repeated validation operations, separate for canonical49, RHF3 and mixed3; construction excluded
policy.caution: Separate scope runs occurred at different times; process tests do not remove systematic environment bias. This analysis is descriptive/exploratory, not an independently predeclared confirmation.
